author: Mark Atwood
text:
Resolved for the canonical (mail-server) and chat-server. 6 remaining sibling extension-server crates split off to JMAP-x2gd.103 for the propagation sweep.

## What landed

- **jmap-server** (foundation): 1 site cleaned in src/lib.rs (Dispatcher handler lookup).
- **jmap-mail-server** (canonical extension-server): 9 sites cleaned across email.rs, identity.rs, memory/mod.rs, sieve.rs.
- **jmap-chat-server** (sibling): 14 sites cleaned across ban.rs, chat.rs, invite.rs, memory.rs, message.rs, position.rs.

24 sites in total, all converted to the let-else / if-let-else idiom (option a in the bead). One memory/mod.rs site kept the if-let-else shape (its else arm assigns to a let-binding from outside, so let-else doesn't fit). One memory.rs site in chat-server was a match-with-side-effects-in-both-arms that became if-let-else.

## Remaining

Filed JMAP-x2gd.103 for the 6 other sibling extension-server crates (calendars 5, contacts 4, filenode 4, metadata 4, sharing 2, tasks 5 = 24 more sites). They're all independent now that the canonical is converged.

## Gates

- cargo check --workspace --all-features: clean
- cargo clippy -p jmap-server -p jmap-mail-server -p jmap-chat-server --all-features -- -D warnings: clean
- cargo clippy -p jmap-chat-server -p jmap-mail-server -p jmap-server --all-features --lib -- -W clippy::single_match_else: ZERO hits remaining in these three crates
- cargo test -p jmap-chat-server -p jmap-mail-server -p jmap-server --all-features: all passing
- cargo fmt --all: clean

Diff: 11 files, +208 / -251 (net -43 lines because let-else is more compact than match-with-else-arm).

Partially closes JMAP-x2gd.89. Sibling crate sweep tracked under JMAP-x2gd.103.
